points.source_of_truth: sum of point_delta in the active learner logs

rules: J-CLES and English CLES must use different localStorage keys.
Question-bank JSON must never contain personal logs.
Import merges and de-duplicates logs; it does not overwrite history.
Backup before changing URL or domain because localStorage is origin-scoped.
The active learner name selects that learner's statistics and points.
